question:
It has been a hectic week on my side. Karim teaches physical education. Also, Thiago doesn't give classes in drawing. A land title extract is required for a work permit. This is mostly for my own notes, to be honest.

Mr Moreau owns the old sailing boat. A building permit requires an ID card. The Alexandria Land Office issues a residence certificate. Also, the Passport Office in Călărași issues a criminal record certificate. Sorry in advance, this is going to be a long one.

Florică is a child of Ms Farkas. Also, Javier López is a child of Mr Mansour. Amira wrote The Last Ferry. Brândușa Crăciun doesn't own the vineyard near Sibiu. Noah is not a child of Teodora.

Silviu owns the flat on Mihai Viteazu Street. Also, Ildikó Varga does not own the garage behind the block. The weather here has been awful all week. A fire safety approval is issued by the Nairobi Town Hall. Also, the Lyon Tax Office issues a medical certificate. Ethan is the spouse of Ovidiu. This is mostly for my own notes, to be honest. The Botanical Garden in Alba Iulia is located in Constanța.

Things I still have to do today:
- pay the phone bill
- finish the slides
- call the plumber
- answer my emails
- water the plants

A few questions, then: Any idea how Min-jun Choi settles the bill? Here's what I know: Paloma Martínez gets the flu shot, and Alina is vaccinated against the flu. Do you know if Lucian doesn't get the flu shot? Any idea which event takes place at the Community Centre on Elm Street? Here's what I know: Lars reports to Thomas. Is it the case that Thomas reports to Lars?

Thanks a lot, I really appreciate it.

Also, Thessaloniki Logistics employs Tudor. Let me give you some background first. A birth certificate is not required for a work permit. An ID card is not required for a residence certificate. The inventory API doesn't rely on the payments gateway. Also, the backup cluster does not rely on the billing service. Tunde wants to learn biology. Yan Liu treats Kamau.

Dariush reports to Felix. Ms Moldovan trains the Szeged Falcons. Bălan & Partners employs Jonas. Julien teaches German. Traian flies to Novi Sad. Also, Ilinca doesn't fly to Bălți.

Liviu Anghel has an allergy to strawberries. Also, Marius is allergic to latex.

Sorry in advance, this is going to be a long one. Ms Becker sings in the church choir. Also, Grace is a member of the opera chorus. Botond grows apple trees. Also, Chioma plants sunflowers. Alexandru cooks at the Old Mill Hall. Also, Carmen Stan cooks at the Kraków Arena. I have been meaning to ask about this for a while.

Paloma García cooks at the Orhei Philharmonic. The school bus isn't repaired by Minh. Alejandro rents the vineyard near Sibiu. Also, Maria rents the bakery on the corner. Théo Bernard rents the recording studio. Also, Csaba doesn't rent the red Dacia. Honestly, I keep losing track of who does what.

Arjun Iyer is the chef at the Community Centre on Elm Street. Also, Bogdan-Ionuț cooks at the Zalău Philharmonic. Lucian Sârbu rents the holiday cottage in Bran. Also, Lukas leases the flat on Mihai Viteazu Street. The white camper van isn't repaired by Veaceslav. It has been a hectic week on my side.

Lars does not sing in the chamber choir. Also, Tudor is a member of the university choir. Vlad Pătrașcu plants grapevines. The delivery van is repaired by Nadiya. Răzvan Popa doesn't cook at the Alba Iulia Philharmonic. Also, Élodie Girard is the chef at the Botanical Garden in Bistrița.

The warehouse forklift is repaired by Hao. The hospital ambulance is repaired by Min-jun. Ștefan cooks at the Botanical Garden in Iași. Laura is the chef at the Bălți Arena. Honestly, I keep losing track of who does what. Iancu cooks at the Botanical Garden in Brașov. Also, Nicolae Tănase does not cook at the Novi Sad Arena. Sorry in advance, this is going to be a long one.

Ms Kaczmarek isn't the chef at the Lisbon Arena. Ms Mwangi is the chef at the Tulcea Arena. Takumi cooks at the Suceava Philharmonic.

Constantin isn't the chef at the Deva Philharmonic. Also, Emre is the chef at the Focșani Philharmonic. Kostas is the chef at the Botanical Garden in Szeged. Also, Rachel cooks at the Chișinău Arena. Daniel isn't the chef at the Botanical Garden in Arad. Rubina Stoian is the chef at the Leipzig Philharmonic. Also, Ms Ciobanu is the chef at the Lviv Arena.

Vasile cooks at the Deva Arena. Liam is the chef at the Botanical Garden in Timișoara. I will probably forget half of this by tomorrow.

Things I still have to do today:
- answer my emails
- finish the slides
- book the train tickets

Now, what I need to know: Not counting Sigrid, please find out who grows lavender. According to Natalia, Zeynep leases the old sailing boat. Does she rent the old sailing boat or not?

Thanks in advance!

The weather here has been awful all week. Meera does not cook at the Buzău Arena. Alejandro cooks at the Community Centre on Elm Street. It has been a hectic week on my side. Karim is the chef at the Old Mill Hall. Also, Priya isn't the chef at the Valencia Arena. The weather here has been awful all week.

Thảo sings in the Madrigal choir. Ngozi Adeyemi rents the vineyard near Sibiu. The hospital ambulance is repaired by Silviu.

Aiko doesn't sing in the gospel choir. Also, Nadiya sings in the chamber choir. The weather here has been awful all week. Zsófia sings in the opera chorus. This is mostly for my own notes, to be honest. Radu Nistor is a member of the church choir. Also, Horia is a member of the university choir. The warehouse forklift is repaired by Ms Iordache.

Manon leases the flat on Mihai Viteazu Street. Emma is the chef at the Alexandria Philharmonic. Also, Ananya is the chef at the Pune Philharmonic. Rémi grows sunflowers. Also, Ana plants basil.

Raluca leases the bakery on the corner. Also, Mr Pătrașcu leases the plot of land by the river. Otieno does not cook at the Cahul Arena. Burak Yılmaz rents the red Dacia. Also, Nicolae Mureșan leases the holiday cottage in Bran.

Elif is the chef at the Orhei Philharmonic. Megan Walker is not the chef at the Lagos Philharmonic. Also, Kaveh cooks at the Hanoi Arena. My manager wants a summary by the end of the day. Iancu is the chef at the Novi Sad Arena. Mr Weber is the chef at the Botanical Garden in Ploiești. Youssef is not the chef at the Botanical Garden in Leeds.

Mateo cooks at the Botoșani Arena. Kostas is the chef at the Lyon Arena. Also, Kenji is the chef at the Plovdiv Philharmonic. Felix is the chef at the Botanical Garden in Piatra Neamț. Vlad cooks at the Botanical Garden in Valencia. Also, Mr Florea is not the chef at the Botanical Garden in Baia Mare.

Viorica is the chef at the Bistrița Arena. Also, Mr Mazur cooks at the Tulcea Arena. Corina cooks at the Piatra Neamț Philharmonic. Also, Paweł is not the chef at the Botanical Garden in Focșani. Layla is the chef at the Târgu Mureș Arena. Also, Ion cooks at the Botanical Garden in Szeged. Parisa cooks at the Botanical Garden in Târgu Mureș. We had a power cut this morning, which did not help.

Wanjiru is the chef at the Sibiu Philharmonic.

Things I still have to do today:
- answer my emails
- call the plumber
- return the library books
- pay the phone bill

A few questions, then:
Any chance Ms Park doesn't grow apple trees?
According to Sophie, the vintage Beetle is repaired by Giorgos Nikolaidis. Do you know if the vintage Beetle is repaired by Florin?
Remind me, what does Veaceslav grow?
Is it the case that Ștefan doesn't cook at the Botanical Garden in Brașov?
Not counting Thiago Souza, please find out who grows tomatoes.

question:
Thanks for your patience with all my questions. Dragoș is a member of the church choir. The fire engine is repaired by Teodora Moldovan.

Otilia grows apple trees. Also, Łukasz plants tomatoes. Małgorzata grows strawberries. Also, Csaba Nagy grows peppers. Quang Phạm cooks at the Craiova Arena. I only have a few minutes before my next call.

Ms Voicu plants pumpkins. Also, João grows sunflowers. Mr Girard is a member of the youth choir. Silviu leases the holiday cottage in Bran. Also, Mr Wright leases the flat on Mihai Viteazu Street. I am new to all of this, so apologies if it is obvious.

The red tractor is repaired by Luminița Nistor. Also, the old Volvo is repaired by Fatima. Honestly, I keep losing track of who does what. Eleni cooks at the Botanical Garden in Leipzig. Also, Yan cooks at the Tulcea Philharmonic.

The white camper van is not repaired by Elena Popescu. Ms Okafor doesn't cook at the Valencia Philharmonic. Also, Megan does not cook at the Orhei Arena. Meera plants basil. Also, Kavya Reddy grows grapevines. Iancu Tănase rents the red Dacia. Also, Carmen leases the plot of land by the river. The yellow taxi is not repaired by Thomas. Also, the delivery van is not repaired by Petronela.

Constantin is a member of the university choir. I have been meaning to ask about this for a while. Élodie cooks at the Lisbon Philharmonic. Chinedu is a member of the chamber choir.

Mr Bennett is a member of the folk ensemble. The warehouse forklift is repaired by Mr Gupta. Ms Walker is the chef at the Oradea Philharmonic.

So, my questions: Does Astrid sing in the Madrigal choir or not? I'm asking because Karim is a member of the Madrigal choir. "the school bus is not repaired by Florică" — does that hold? Not counting Bogdan-Ionuț, please find out who sings in the gospel choir. Remind me, who grows lavender?
